messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up: KrakenPay onboarding — PM noticed repeated mobile timeouts during address autocompletion. Baseline p50 ~1.9s, p99 ~4.6s. Renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks, want proactive ops.

zoe_cs: attaching short trace + sample prompts: https://redwood.internal/traces/kraken/246789/mini.zip :mag_right:

frank_se: quick scan shows many short prefix requests (<50 tokens) but hitting rwd-gpt-7b-fp16 cold path. We can try: 1) route tiny requests to rwd-lite-0.7; 2) enable int8 for main path; 3) aggressive kv prefix cache for sessions.

mika_ml: agree. Proposed thresholds: require eval on 800 recent prompts. Metrics: top-1 intent accuracy, completion BLEU-like score on templates. Allow <=1% intent drop and <=1.5pp BLEU loss.

juno_ops: capacity check: us-west-2 has 10 GPUs free. Recommend starting canary at 4% traffic, batch-size 4. I can reserve capacity window.

ci-bot: preflight: model rwd-gpt-7b-int8 image validated. Integration tests: passed.

frank_se: sample redwoodctl snippet for ticket:
```bash
redwoodctl routes create --account krakenpay --name kp-perf-canary \
  --policy "canary=4,region=us-west-2,model=rwd-gpt-7b-int8" \
  --short-route "threshold=50,model=rwd-lite-0.7,confidence=0.86" \
  --fallback "rwd-gpt-7b-fp16" --batch-size 4
```

mika_ml: eval plan: run 800 prompts through both int8 and lite candidate; report delta by morning. If intent drop >1% hold. Also seed eval with 20 known customer-critical prompts.

zoe_cs: I'll ask KrakenPay for the 20 critical prompts and propose a 2-hour window next Tue morning. Also include opt-out instructions.

juno_ops: I'll prepare Grafana dashboard and Slack alert (#kp-canary-alerts) with triggers: +0.6pp error, p95 latency regression, intent-acc delta >1%.

frank_se: small ops note: enable 'quant_fallback=true' and 'kv_prefix_window=128' in rollout config to avoid regressions.

zoe_cs: thanks everyone 1: compiling into playbook and creating the support ticket. Will post eval-bot results here. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: eval job queued 7709. ETA ~90m.
